title: CCP: density threshold 8 in impls+vectors contradicts decision >10
description: DIVERGENT (final decision density-high says DENSITY_HIGH>10; spec text fixed to >10; but all three implementations and committed vectors use >8). Req: 'IF Density > 10 THEN RETURN 0' (2a.3.1); 'Density>DENSITY_HIGH(10) MUST use CH0 + SF>=11' (2a.8/2a.10.5); duty dense tier density>10 (2a.9). Evidence: python/src/lichen/ccp.py:105,350,375 and timing/duty_cycle.py:60-76 use >8; rust/lichen-core/src/rf_health.rs:386,653 use DENSITY_HIGH=8; lichen/subsys/lichen/link/link_ctx.c:705, lichen/subsys/lichen/routing/gradient.c:320, lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/lora_l2_tx.c:587 use >8. Vectors pin 8: ccp16.json select_channel_timing_test (density=9->CH0), ccp13.json dense_start_region0 (density=9->5 permille). Commit 521ce0968d set 8. Python has TWO divergent selectors: ccp.py (>8) vs link/adaptive_sf.py:137 (>10). Python test tests/test_ccp.py:106 pins 9->CH0. Fix: change DENSITY_HIGH to 10 in all three impls, regenerate affected vectors (ccp16.json, ccp13.json, ccp15.json, ccp16_load_balance.json), update Python tests pinning 9->CH0, unify python ccp.py with link/adaptive_sf.py and channel_plan.py duplicates. Suggested placement: python/src/lichen/ccp.py + python/src/lichen/link/adaptive_sf.py + python/src/lichen/channel_plan.py + python/src/lichen/timing/duty_cycle.py; rust/lichen-core/src/{rf_health.rs,duty_cycle.rs}; lichen/subsys/lichen/link/link_ctx.c + lichen/subsys/lichen/routing/gradient.c + lichen/subsys/lichen/l2/lora_l2_tx.c; test/vectors generators.
